q: When will tickets for the Varanasi stadium go on sale?
a: Only after a match is officially announced. Nothing has been announced yet, so no tickets exist. We'll put the official link on our tickets page the day sales open.
Prices haven't been announced. They're set by the organisers for each match, so they'll differ between a Ranji Trophy game and an IPL or WPL match.
Only on the ticketing platform BCCI or UPCA names for that match. We'll link to it on this page. Don't trust any other seller.

q: Someone on WhatsApp or Instagram is selling tickets. Are they real?
a: No. No tickets exist for this stadium yet, so anyone selling them now is running a scam. Don't pay, and report it at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

q: Can you book tickets for me?
a: No. We never sell or book tickets. We only tell you when and where the official sale opens.
